description: This file defines Express.js routes for handling CRUD operations related to LLM cost records. It provides endpoints for listing, retrieving by ID, creating, updating, and deleting cost entries, with Swagger documentation annotations included.

methods.name: router.get
methods.description: Registers a GET endpoint at '/' for listing LLM cost records with optional pagination, sorting, and filtering.

methods.name: router.get('/:id')
methods.description: Registers a GET endpoint at '/:id' to retrieve a specific LLM cost record by ID.

methods.name: router.post('/')
methods.description: Registers a POST endpoint at '/' to create a new LLM cost record.

methods.name: router.put('/:id')
methods.description: Registers a PUT endpoint at '/:id' to update an existing LLM cost record by ID.

methods.name: router.delete('/:id')
methods.description: Registers a DELETE endpoint at '/:id' to remove an LLM cost record by ID.
